posts.text: That's a wrap on our first-ever Toronto Startup Showcase 🥳 We loved the energy and excitement our attendees brought to our event! A special thank you to all the founders who pitched — we're inspired by your passion and we're excited about your journey ahead 🚀 Want to be in the loop about future events hosted by RippleX Fellowship?
